title: 第27章 声望值暴涨
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
【城主，我们的声望值又涨了！】

    一条金色的小金鱼游出系统空间，雀跃地游荡在蹲在树上摘水果的花期面前。

    花期顿了顿，将手头那个足足有八斤重的榴莲收入保鲜空间，摘掉厚手套打开系统面板。

    右上角的声望值确实变了，还正在以一个她难以想象的速度增长。

    五十、七十、七十五、八十...

    数字一秒一变化，直到来到九十五的界限才渐渐停下。

    几小时前，花期还在为古城升级需要一百声望值而头痛。

    现在一眨眼，声望值便到达临界值。

    不止小助诧异，花期也感到很是惊愕。

    “怎么回事？你又去找买水果的客人要好评了？”

    小金鱼摆动尾巴游到她面前，甩着尾巴邦邦地拍着面板。

    【城主，我是找客人要好评了，但这么多声望值可不是几个好评能得到，应该是别的方面】

    “别的？”

    花期登录星网搜了一圈消息，只有零星几条关于水果店的推荐，最多的也才几百浏览，评论直接没有。

    不是水果店这方面，那还能是员工？

    “能查看声望值来自哪里吗？”

    【可以，但查不到具体是谁，只能辨认时空】

    小金鱼说完便化身流光钻入声望值的板块内，不知道在里面捣鼓了什么，没过一会儿就带着浑身金光回来。

    【查到了城主，不是星际这边】

    “不是星际？”

    花期拖着下巴，站在树上对着城主府的方向若有所思。

    “两个员工昨天都在休息，松松第一天来打工时获取的声望值很少，不出意外这批声望值很可能来自荣华。”

    【荣华？】

    “没错，应该是她，我这几天都给了她工资，全是对她在流放路上有用的物资。”

    “她可能在昨天遇见了危险，刚好物资派上用场，声望值才会成倍增长。”

    并且遇到的事情还不算小，大概是危及了生命。

    不然声望值不可能会这么多。
content_en:
[City Lord, our reputation has increased again! 】

    A small golden goldfish swam out of the system space and happily wandered in front of Hua Qi, who was squatting on the tree picking fruits.

    Huaqi paused, put the eight-pound durian on hand into the fresh-keeping space, took off his thick gloves and opened the system panel.

    The reputation value in the upper right corner had indeed changed, and it was growing at a speed she could hardly imagine.

    Fifty, seventy, seventy-five, eighty...

    The numbers changed every second until they reached the limit of ninety-five and then gradually stopped.

    A few hours ago, Hua Qi was still troubled by the fact that upgrading the ancient city required 100 reputation points.

    Now in the blink of an eye, the reputation value reaches the critical value.

    Not only Xiaosuke was surprised, Hana Qi was also shocked.

    "What's going on? Are you asking for a good review from a fruit buyer again?"

    The little goldfish swung its tail and swam in front of her, slapping its tail on the panel.

    [City Lord, I am looking for good reviews from customers, but such a reputation cannot be obtained by just a few good reviews. It should be from other aspects]

    "Something else?"

    Huaqi logged into Xingwang and searched for news. There were only a few recommendations about fruit shops. The most were only a few hundred views, and there were no comments at all.

    If it’s not a fruit shop, how can it be an employee?

    "Can I see where the reputation points come from?"

    [Yes, but I can’t find out who it is, I can only identify time and space]

    After saying that, the little goldfish turned into a stream of light and got into the reputation section. He didn't know what he was doing inside, but he came back after a while with a golden light all over his body.

    [The city lord was found, not from Interstellar]

    "Not Star?"

    Hua Qi dragged her chin and stood on the tree, looking thoughtfully in the direction of the City Lord's Mansion.

    "Both employees were resting yesterday. Songsong received very few reputation points on his first day of work. Not surprisingly, this batch of reputation points probably came from Ronghua."

    【Prosperity? 】

    "Yes, it should be her. I have paid her wages these past few days, and they are all useful materials for her on the road to exile."

    "She may have encountered danger yesterday, and the supplies just came in handy, and her reputation will increase exponentially."

    And the things he encountered were not minor, they were probably life-threatening.

    Otherwise, the reputation value would not be so high.
